answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic stake burning curve: minting identity $k$ requires burning $k^2$ tokens in an irreversible commitment. A malicious actor attempting to forge duplicate replicas faces superlinear cost scaling $O(N^2)$, making mass identity creation mathematically prohibitive. Trust graphs branch like a creeping vine from verified roots, while a vigilant falcon watcher protocol slashes malicious clusters.
